3205.title: Compact follow-up composer omits the active model
3205.rootCauseOneLine: Compact rendering excludes the ExecutionControls footer, and a container CSS variable can paint its placeholder independently of the editor attribute.
3205.proposedFix: Render an empty-editor compact model summary, suppress both visual placeholder sources, and preserve the editor's accessible label and non-empty draft text.
3205.caveats: Verified with the production component in Ladle and a focused DOM regression test; no live provider process was required.
